changelog:
**Initial public release of android-control skill.**

- Android remote control and screen understanding engine for OpenClaw, based on UI automation and ADB integration.
- Supports device pool management, heartbeat, UI hierarchy analysis, element search and interaction, app launch/stop, messaging (inc. WeChat), visual analysis, and safe messaging actions.
- Added documentation (README.md, LICENSE, _meta.json) and removed legacy skill-card.md.
- Modernized skill description, usage instructions, and scenario workflows in SKILL.md.
- ClawHub changelog, usage, best practices, and verification/recovery guidelines provided.
summary: Control Android devices via OpenClaw using ADB, wireless debugging, Termux, intents, UI automation, app launching, screenshots, logging, and safe message act...
